definitions.explanation: A critical evaluation, especially of literary or artistic works. Often used in the context of professional reviews.

examples.japanese: その{映画|えいが}は{批評家|ひひょうか}に{高|たか}く{評価|ひょうか}された。
examples.english: The movie was highly rated by critics.

examples.japanese: {新聞|しんぶん}の{書評|しょひょう}で{厳|きび}しい{批評|ひひょう}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: It received harsh criticism in the newspaper book review.

examples.japanese: {文学|ぶんがく}{批評|ひひょう}を{専門|せんもん}としている。

notes:
USAGE: {批評|ひひょう} is commonly used for formal critiques of art, literature, music, and performances. It tends to be more analytical and professional than casual criticism.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{批評|ひひょう}する (to critique/review)
・{批評|ひひょう}を{書|か}く (to write a review)
・{批評|ひひょう}{家|か} (critic)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{批判|ひはん} - criticism (broader, including political/social)
・{論評|ろんぴょう} - commentary, critique (more formal)
